events.title: Bird Jaguar IV becomes king of Yaxchilan
events.description: Bird Jaguar IV became king of Yaxchilan, a Maya city on the Usumacinta River in modern Chiapas, and ruled until 768. Not perceived as the rightful heir, he had to struggle to take and hold power.

events.title: Otto III's cousin Bruno of Carinthia becomes Pope Gregory V
events.description: Following the death of Pope John XV, the German king Otto III chose his cousin Bruno of Carinthia, a member of the Salian dynasty, as pope. Bruno took the name Gregory V, and Otto became Holy Roman Emperor the same year.

events.title: Niccolò Machiavelli is born in Florence
events.description: Machiavelli, diplomat of the Florentine republic and author of The Prince, was born. His unsentimental analysis of power made him a founder of modern political thought.
events.html: Machiavelli, diplomat of the Florentine republic and author of The Prince, was born. His unsentimental analysis of power made him a founder of modern political thought.

events.title: Columbus sights Jamaica on his second voyage
events.description: Christopher Columbus reached Jamaica, which the Taíno called Xaymaca, and named it Santiago. The island remained under Spanish rule until England captured it in 1655.
events.html: Christopher Columbus reached Jamaica, which the Taíno called Xaymaca, and named it Santiago. The island remained under Spanish rule until England captured it in 1655.

events.title: Treaty of Oliva makes peace between Sweden and Poland
events.description: Signed near Danzig, the treaty ended the war between Sweden and Poland-Lithuania. Poland's king renounced his claim to the Swedish throne and recognised Swedish rule in Livonia.
events.html: Signed near Danzig, the treaty ended the war between Sweden and Poland-Lithuania. Poland's king renounced his claim to the Swedish throne and recognised Swedish rule in Livonia.

events.title: Poland-Lithuania adopts the Constitution of 3 May
events.description: The Sejm passed Europe's first modern codified national constitution, strengthening the monarchy and ending the liberum veto. Russia and Prussia responded with war and the second partition.
events.html: The Sejm passed Europe's first modern codified national constitution, strengthening the monarchy and ending the liberum veto. Russia and Prussia responded with war and the second partition.

events.title: Napoleon arrives off Elba to begin his exile
events.description: HMS Undaunted brought the deposed emperor to Portoferraio, where he landed the next morning to rule his tiny island principality. He escaped in February 1815.
events.html: HMS Undaunted brought the deposed emperor to Portoferraio, where he landed the next morning to rule his tiny island principality. He escaped in February 1815.

events.title: Northern Ireland comes into being
events.description: The Government of Ireland Act took effect, partitioning Ireland and creating Northern Ireland from six north-eastern counties with its own parliament. Partition remains in place today.

events.title: Margaret Mitchell wins the Pulitzer for Gone with the Wind
events.description: Margaret Mitchell's novel of the Civil War and Reconstruction won the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction. A huge bestseller, it was filmed in 1939, though its portrayal of slavery is now widely criticised.

intl.name: World Press Freedom Day
intl.description: Proclaimed by the UN General Assembly in 1993 on the anniversary of the Windhoek Declaration, World Press Freedom Day affirms that a free press is essential to democracy and evaluates the state of press freedom worldwide.
